title: Geometric bias in eigenspace perturbation under random heterogeneous noise
abstract: arXiv:2606.11263v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Spectral methods rely on the stability of principal eigenspaces under random perturbations. Classically, this is quantified by the Davis-Kahan and Wedin theorems, which bound the eigenspace error via the operator norm of the noise and the relevant spectral gaps. While sharp for arbitrary deterministic perturbations, these worst-case bounds can be wasteful in the low-rank signal-plus-noise setting, as they fail to capture the interaction between the signal geometry and the noise distribution. We study the spectral perturbation of signal-plus-noise matrices corrupted by sparse random noise with an arbitrary, inhomogeneous variance profile. Under heterogeneous variances, the empirical eigenvectors suffer a systematic, deterministic geometric bias invisible to classical bounds. translated_title: 随机异构噪声下特征空间扰动中的几何偏差
translated_abstract: 摘要：arXiv:2606.11263v2 公告类型：替换-交叉 摘要：谱方法依赖于主特征空间在随机扰动下的稳定性。经典上，这通过Davis-Kahan和Wedin定理来量化，这些定理利用噪声的算子范数和相关谱间隙来界定特征空间误差。尽管这些最坏情况下的界对于任意确定性扰动是尖锐的，但在低秩信号加噪声的背景下，它们可能过于浪费，因为它们未能捕捉信号几何结构与噪声分布之间的交互作用。我们研究了由具有任意非齐次方差轮廓的稀疏随机噪声破坏的信号加噪声矩阵的谱扰动。在异构方差下，经验特征向量遭受系统性的、确定性的几何偏差，经典界无法捕捉到这一点。利用二次向量方程（QVE）和精细的各向同性局部律，我们推导了主导特征空间的近最优、非渐近界。
tldr: 本文发现随机异构噪声导致特征向量产生经典界无法捕捉的确定性几何偏差，并提出基于QVE和局部律的改进近最优界。
en_tdlr: This paper reveals a deterministic geometric bias in eigenvectors under heterogeneous random noise, overlooked by classical bounds, and provides near-optimal non-asymptotic bounds via QVE and local laws.
